_comment: Failure Probability Configuration — Realistic Mode. Per domain-entities.md (FailureProbabilityConfig) and business-rules.md (BR-6). Tunable without redeploying code (Q3: B) — e.g. workshop facilitators can adjust pacing by editing this file and redeploying only the Lambda package. Uses JSON (not YAML) specifically so no third-party pyyaml dependency is needed at Lambda runtime — Code.from_asset() does not pip-install dependencies, and json is a Python stdlib module (real bug found during first live deployment: pyyaml ImportError at runtime, since it was never actually bundled into the Lambda zip).
